theorems.name: Submission.canonicalCarrier_rectifiablePair_weight
theorems.statement: ApproxTangentAE → ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ) (U : Set (Ambient n ℓ)), 0 < n → IsOpen U → IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts V.weight → (∀ ξ ∈ U, V.HasDensityAt ξ (V.density ξ)) → IsRectifiablePair n (V.canonicalCarrier U) V.density ∧ pairWeight n (V.canonicalCarrier U) V.density = V.weight.restrict U
